Where architecture meets emotion.

SERAPH is an avant-garde digital couture piece designed to blur the boundary between sculpture and fashion. Inspired by celestial forms, organic structures, and architectural silhouettes, this garment combines dramatic volume with elegant craftsmanship.

Every element has been carefully developed inside CLO3D using premium digital construction techniques to achieve a highly detailed silhouette suitable for professional visualization.

The garment is ideal for:

• Digital Fashion Projects

• Concept Art

• Fashion Visualization

• Metaverse Content

• Editorial Renders

• Portfolio Presentations

title: The Spirit of Ukraine | My Entry for the CLO 3D Football Design Compet
content:
![443b0dd26b0a436ebc28c780e0790878](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/8ac7cbb0f06a41e098a77adf0d6a8f15/images/443b0dd26b0a436ebc28c780e0790878ANASTASIIAZAHATSKA%205.png)Hello everyone! 👋 My name is Anastasiia.

I’m participating in the **CLO 3D Football Design Competition** , and this is the project I’ve poured my heart into. It means a great deal to me, and I truly hope it reaches as many people as possible.

When people hear the word _football_ , they usually think of stadiums, cheering crowds, and the referee's whistle. When I think of football, I remember something different: people gathering in bomb shelters during air raid alerts, still watching a match together on a phone screen. I remember children in my hometown playing football in the courtyard between air raid sirens—simply because they want to remain children, even if only for an hour.

I am from Ukraine. For almost five years, my country has lived under constant attacks, losing people, homes, and entire cities. Yet we continue to create, compete, and move forward. That is the strength I wanted to express in my design.

When I began working on this project, I wasn't simply creating a garment. I was thinking about what football means to Ukrainians today. It is no longer just a sport—it is a way of telling ourselves, and the world: **we are still here, we are still playing, and we will not give up.** Every detail, every fabric texture, and every symbol in my design is a small gesture meant to show the world not only our struggle, but also our culture, our aesthetics, and our ability to create beauty even in the darkest times.

Participating in this competition is about more than winning a place. It is an opportunity to step onto the international stage and say: **"Look—this is Ukraine."** Not only the Ukraine you see in the headlines every day, but the Ukraine that creates, designs, innovates, and competes alongside the rest of the world. A Ukraine that wants to be seen not as a victim, but as an equal. Every element of this garment carries the **Spirit of Ukraine**.

I would also like to express my sincere gratitude to the founders and the entire **CLO 3D** team for creating a tool that allowed me to bring this vision to life exactly as I imagined it.

The realistic fabric simulation made it possible to show how every layer of the garment naturally drapes and moves—from delicate embroidery to heavier outer elements—as if they were made from real materials rather than existing only in a digital environment. Because of this, even the smallest details, such as the embroidery textures and the badges, look authentic and believable.

Working with digital patterns and fabrics gave me complete creative freedom. I could refine the silhouette, proportions, construction, and details as many times as necessary without wasting physical materials or producing multiple prototypes, allowing me to search for the perfect expression of my concept, **"The Spirit of Ukraine."**

What impressed me most was the way CLO 3D combines technical precision with creative freedom. I could develop every individual element—the coat of arms, the football crest, the embroidery, and the ornaments—and immediately see how they interacted with the entire garment in real time.

Thanks to this software, an idea that once existed only in my imagination became a visual reality. It allowed me to represent my country exactly as I wanted: through craftsmanship, texture, symbolism, and form. I am deeply grateful to the founders and the entire CLO 3D team for creating a platform that gives designers a voice, even when real-world circumstances make creativity incredibly difficult.

When my work appears alongside designs from creators around the world, it will feel like my own personal match. And I want to play that match with dignity—for my country.

If my project resonates with you, I would be sincerely grateful for your support. Every view, like, comment, or share means more to me than you can imagine. Thank you so much. 🙏![6fd513d4c34a489b8527f8e99fd71f66](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/8ac7cbb0f06a41e098a77adf0d6a8f15/images/6fd513d4c34a489b8527f8e99fd71f66ANASTASIIAZAHATSKA%202.png)🔗 Link to my work which will be open after the start: <https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/5939e4a08c694568bebed11d78acc8df>

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Beatiful design ❤️
Reply 1: Thank you very much❤️
content_description: Showcasing Anastasiia Zahatska’s heartfelt CLO 3D football design that embodies the resilience, culture, and spirit of Ukraine amidst adversity.

title: Aethera – Futuristic Female Bodysuit
content:
## ![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/099fac71bfd74239b3a9a0c51a8427e2Final.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/7b9db4e9d7924e61a492549f309b7414Untitled-1.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/0abb38318b284ad8b03686065b24040b70c002b6-03ac-4011-93c7-0cb2f861c7e2.png)**Aethera – A Bodysuit Beyond Species**

Aethera was born from a simple design concept:

**To create a garment that could be worn by both humans and extraterrestrial beings.**

Rather than designing clothing for a single species, I explored the idea of a universal bodysuit that feels equally natural on humanoid lifeforms from different worlds. The silhouette combines asymmetrical armor elements with ribbed textile panels, balancing protection, flexibility, and mobility while maintaining a clean futuristic aesthetic.

The contrast between weathered metallic surfaces and soft fabrics emphasizes the coexistence of advanced technology and wearable comfort. Every panel was carefully shaped to create a design that could belong to a future where fashion is no longer limited to Earth.

The garment was created in **CLO3D / Marvelous Designer** and textured with **4K PBR materials** , making it suitable for digital fashion, game characters, cinematics, virtual production, and real-time rendering.  
![fb938e74bab44c1091fbefdd45f548ce](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/fb938e74bab44c1091fbefdd45f548ce2.jpg)![03cec4a9ff654d4aabde7581be6a2120](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/03cec4a9ff654d4aabde7581be6a2120Final_textyer1_1.png)![50d22b6a70294a01823b8abad6b9608c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/50d22b6a70294a01823b8abad6b9608cFinal_textyer1_4.png)![caa6c1e8dcd24a178399b19a44e9b85a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/caa6c1e8dcd24a178399b19a44e9b85aFinal_textyer1_3.png)![bf021f27779043bf98ce75c35d58c0ed](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/bf021f27779043bf98ce75c35d58c0edFinal_textyer1_2.png)![fc6d5fc54588445280064cf1de22f29c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/48ee86e007784dd195d026ae894795f3/images/fc6d5fc54588445280064cf1de22f29cScreenshot%202026-07-27%20120700.png)
